description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain operated by Neapolitan Pizza Ltd., with over 25 years in the pizza industry and locations across the Lower Mainland and beyond. The Metrotown location serves wood-fired pizzas with authentic charred crusts, classic Italian toppings, and outdoor seating — a reasonable stop for a cyclist coming through Burnaby's commercial core. Pickup, delivery, and a mobile rewards app are all available.
